one_line: A skilled builder from the Qutb Complex workshops in Mehrauli, c. 13th–14th century Delhi Sultanate.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but strong craftsman’s build with calloused hands and steady posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, warm medium‑brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a faint chisel scar on the left cheek, calm focused eyes with a default expression of quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Black hair worn short and tidy under a simple off‑white cotton turban wrapped low around the head, with one slim tail of cloth tucked at the back and no decorative ornaments.
appearance.costume: A knee‑length, straight‑cut indigo cotton angarkha tied at the right side with thin fabric cords and faint block‑printed geometric borders, worn over a loose off‑white cotton kurta whose sleeves show at the wrists; paired with light brown cotton churidar-style fitted trousers gathered at the ankles, and simple dark leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; a narrow reddish‑brown cotton waist sash wraps once around his middle and is knotted at the left hip, with a small cloth pouch tied into it.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly weathered iron mason’s hammer with a rectangular head and wooden handle, carried in his right hand, plus a flat measuring rod of pale wood tucked under his left arm.

ref_desc: A lean medium‑brown mason with short black hair under an off‑white turban, oval face with a cheek scar, in an indigo angarkha over off‑white kurta, light brown churidar, reddish‑brown sash and dark leather mojari, holding an iron mason’s hammer and wooden measuring rod.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model of a late‑13th‑century Mehrauli master mason from the Qutb Complex: a lean medium‑brown North Indian man in his late twenties, with an oval face, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a small chisel scar on his left cheek, and calm determined eyes. His short black hair is mostly hidden under a simple off‑white cotton turban wrapped close to the skull, with one slim tail tucked at the back. He wears a knee‑length indigo cotton angarkha tied at the right side, with subtle block‑printed geometric borders, over a loose off‑white kurta whose sleeves appear at the wrists. Below, show light brown cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles and dark brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. A narrow reddish‑brown cotton sash is wrapped around his waist and knotted at the left hip, holding a small cloth pouch. In his right hand he carries a long iron mason’s hammer with a rectangular head and wooden handle, and under his left arm he tucks a flat pale‑wood measuring rod. Use indigo blue, off‑white, light brown, reddish‑brown, and dark leather brown as the dominant colours, and pose him neutrally so every element of face, hair, costume and tools is clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
